info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Logistics Shipments Exceptions-v1-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Exceptions API provides insights into exceptions related to logistics shipments. This endpoint allows users to efficiently list various exceptions that may arise during the shipment process, facilitating better management and resolution. Typical consumers of this API include logistics operators and supply chain managers who need to monitor and address exceptions in real-time. By leveraging this functionality, businesses can improve their operational efficiency and enhance customer satisfaction by proactively managing shipment issues.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a list of exceptions related to shipments. It provides detailed information about each exception, enabling users to identify and address issues promptly.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving shipments exception information. The body should contain the necessary parameters as specified in the schema to filter or modify the results returned by the GET operation.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content to return.

ListLogisticsShipmentsExceptionsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to shipment exceptions. It is expected to be a string.

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the shipment reference.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the shipment.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation's outcome.

ListLogisticsShipmentsExceptionsResponse.description: This schema represents the response structure for the shipment exception operation.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the record.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the record was created by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: This schema contains audit information related to the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This can be useful for performance monitoring and optimization.
